about.title: About us
about.metaDescription: Myslyvska Lavka is a specialist store for hunting, fishing and outdoor gear.
about.lead: A specialist store for hunting, fishing and outdoor gear. Gear you can trust.

sections.title: What we sell
paragraphs: Over 50,000 products from 500+ brands: firearms and ammunition, optics, knives and flashlights, clothing, fishing, camping and drone protection gear.

sections.title: How we work
paragraphs: Prices and stock on the website are synchronised with the store’s accounting system. Every product lists its specifications, so you can compare it and check compatibility before buying.
Our consultants help you choose gear for a specific task: hunting, shooting, fishing or hiking.

sections.title: Firearms and ammunition
paragraphs: Firearms, ammunition and other legally regulated goods are sold in accordance with Ukrainian law. Ask our consultants about the purchase conditions.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.metaDescription: Delivery across Ukraine and in-store pickup at Myslyvska Lavka.
delivery.lead: We ship orders across Ukraine from our warehouse or prepare them for pickup.

sections.title: Delivery options
paragraphs: Carrier delivery to a branch, parcel locker or your address. In-store pickup when the item is in stock at the store (shown on the product page).

sections.title: Lead times
paragraphs: Orders with in-stock items are handed to the carrier within 1–2 business days. Delivery time depends on the carrier and your location.

sections.title: Cost
paragraphs: Delivery is charged at the carrier’s rates and shown at checkout.

sections.title: Restricted goods
paragraphs: Firearms, ammunition and other legally regulated goods are handed over in accordance with Ukrainian law. Ask our consultants how to receive them.

sections.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Online card payment at checkout. Payment on delivery at the carrier branch or in the store. Bank transfer for companies against an invoice.

sections.title: Final price
paragraphs: The order total, including discounts and delivery, is recalculated at checkout and shown before you pay.

sections.title: Documents
paragraphs: Every order comes with a fiscal receipt. Companies receive an invoice and a delivery note.

warranty.title: Warranty and returns
warranty.metaDescription: Warranty service, exchanges and returns at Myslyvska Lavka.
warranty.lead: Products are covered by the manufacturer’s warranty. Exchanges and returns follow the Law of Ukraine “On Consumer Protection”.

sections.title: Warranty
paragraphs: The warranty period is stated in the manufacturer’s documents. Keep the receipt and the warranty card, if any, for warranty claims.

sections.title: Exchanges and returns
paragraphs: Products of proper quality can be returned or exchanged within 14 days if unused and with their original condition, seals, labels and packaging intact. Some product categories cannot be returned under the law.

sections.title: How to contact us
paragraphs: Reach us via the Contacts page: describe the issue and give your order number. We will tell you how to send the item for inspection.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.metaDescription: Myslyvska Lavka contacts: phone, e-mail, store address and opening hours.
contacts.lead: We answer questions about products, stock, delivery and orders.

sections.title: Advice
paragraphs: We help you choose gear and check compatibility and warehouse stock. For order questions, have your order number at hand.

sections.title: Pickup
paragraphs: Items in stock at the store can be picked up in person. Store availability is shown on every product page.
